create_slab_from_bulk: create a Slab object from a bulk structure by randomly sampling miller indices and shifts
enumerate_all_slabs: enumerate all symmetrically distinct slabs for a bulk structure up to a given max miller index
compute_slabs_for_millers: compute slabs for specific miller indices from a bulk structure with tiling and tagging
tag_surface_atoms: tag surface atoms as 1 and bulk atoms as 0 using Voronoi coordination and height heuristics
standardize_bulk_structure: standardize a bulk unit cell to its conventional standard structure using space group analysis
